title: digest
description: Tagged SHA-256 digest of a canonical JSON value: 'sha256:' followed by the lowercase hex of the SHA-256 of the canonical bytes. Canonical bytes: object keys are strings sorted by code point; separators are ',' and ':' with no whitespace; strings are UTF-8 with only the JSON-mandatory escapes (quote, backslash and control characters below U+0020; non-ASCII text is written as is); only null, booleans, integers, strings, arrays and objects are allowed, and floats are rejected because their text form is ambiguous between languages. The vectors in vectors.json are the language-neutral test cases.

hex.description: Bare lowercase hex form without the 'sha256:' tag. Legacy (exec/v1 digests); the tagged form is canonical and new contracts use it.
